evals.prompt: the minimap keeps getting clicked by itself
evals.why: A control firing without user intent. Cause is in the ordered hit-test chain plus touch identity: the two edges of one touch each get a decision, so one gesture is counted twice. One of the three touch-identity sets exists specifically to kill this.

evals.prompt: big black bars on the sides and the game only fills a third of my screen
evals.why: Letterboxing and scale. The guest's fixed resolution against an arbitrary device window, resolved in the blit path.

evals.prompt: english text on my overlay is fine but korean comes out as empty space
evals.why: The host's built-in bitmap font is ASCII only. Fix is the closed-set CJK glyph table, and the coverage assertion that turns a missing glyph into a test failure instead of a hole on screen.

evals.prompt: I want players to be able to drag the buttons wherever they like and have it stick
evals.why: The on-device layout editor and the placement model: window fractions and percent-of-builtin, never pixels, resolved to a fixpoint so nothing silently ends up under an obstacle.

evals.prompt: my dpad sticks in one direction after I lift my finger
evals.why: Held-key release discipline and the latched-direction joystick with keyup-before-keydown ordering.

evals.prompt: saves vanish whenever android kills the app in the background
evals.why: App-private storage: synchronous writes so the bytes are on disk when the call returns, plus keeping the on-device layout identical to the headless probe's.

evals.prompt: how do I pop up a real text input box from rust, the game needs a name typed in
evals.why: Text INPUT goes to platform dialogs over JNI. Carries the trap that the JNI context hands you the Application, not the Activity, so the class must be loaded through getClassLoader().

evals.prompt: pinch to resize a control applies the zoom twice and it jumps
evals.why: Deciding twice on one gesture, the same family as the self-clicking minimap. The rule is never to decide on both edges of one touch.

evals.prompt: black screen with no error at all, nothing renders anywhere
evals.why: emulator-core. Total silence with no error is the virtual-clock failure, below this layer. If the host layer were at fault there would be a surface, just the wrong contents.

evals.prompt: I need to find the address of the inventory array inside the game
evals.why: guest-re. Static analysis of the guest image.

evals.prompt: how do I rewrite a data table inside the game jar without breaking the other entries
my release build is somehow still pointing at a localhost address
evals.why: port-shipping. Build-time configuration resolving to a fallback because the variable was not exported when the compiler ran — caught by scanning the produced artifact, not the build script.

evals.prompt: the game connects but hangs forever waiting for a reply from my server
evals.why: server-revival. Blocking-state semantics: exactly one reply clears the wait, and finding it is protocol work.

evals.prompt: the game stutters badly whenever there are lots of sprites on screen
evals.why: emulator-core. Per-draw-call framebuffer round trips in the graphics backend. A useful discrimination test, because 'stutter' feels like a UI-layer complaint and is not.
